name: undo
title: wsync undo
description: Requests Studio to undo one change-history entry.
notes: Drives Studio's own undo stack — the same history as Ctrl+Z in Studio — so it can reverse the user's own edits, not only WSync's. Say what you are about to undo before you undo it.
A completed bulk disk-to-Studio pull is one recording, so one undo reverses the whole pull.
